ffmpeg-7.1-essentials-GPLv3.txt and ffmpeg-7.1-essentials-README.txt were
extracted from
https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/download/7.1/ffmpeg-7.1-essentials_build.zip
published 2024-09-30.

bin/ffmpeg.exe in that zip has SHA256
2ce797a0f88d7f067180338fb227f7b1928ea727bd9a4d7a1d022f7c52af71a3
and is 87638016 bytes. The same hash and size are the ffmpeg-win-x86_64-v7.1.exe
inside imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0 and imageio/imageio-binaries
(commit f8f64710, 2025-01-16, renamed from the binary added the same day).

The README in that zip says License: GPL v3 and
Source Code: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/b08d7969c5
It also lists external library versions, including x264 v0.164.3192 and
x265 4.0-6-ga009ec077. It does not contain those libraries' source trees
or the scripts used to compile and link them. Those two files are evidence
of identity. They are not the corresponding source of the static binary.

reverse-geocoder-LGPL-2.1.txt is a verbatim copy of
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thampiman/reverse-geocoder/master/LICENSE
retrieved on 2026-10-26. It is the GNU Lesser General Public License,
version 2.1. The wheel reverse_geocoder 1.5.1 does not contain this file.
__init__.py SHA256 64b4a62906216d6aa9718fae3b6332f323fc589cb57a048b2be15b1ed6cc0640
and cKDTree_MP.py SHA256 932e77d70058e445a45773115dc22d939f07c2cbb91bc7a9433dc7b4b25b0cf9
match that master tree. The tag URL v1.5.1/LICENSE returned 404.

leaflet-1.9.4-BSD-2-Clause.txt is
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/v1.9.4/LICENSE
SHA256 53e8dc25862014e4324741ca18fbe3611e11d42ef69f59f86ea8c5389647d4cb.
src/orga_drone/static/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js matches unpkg leaflet@1.9.4
dist/leaflet.js SHA256 db49d009c841f5ca34a888c96511ae936fd9f5533e90d8b2c4d57596f4e5641a.

lucide-0.469.0-ISC.txt is
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/0.469.0/LICENSE
SHA256 1e7290b35280a048667bbf0ebabac1c7fd52a75300e8b2946ac165715997f2bc.
Each individual SVG under src/orga_drone/static/vendor/lucide/ matches
lucide-static 0.469.0 on jsDelivr. sprite.svg is assembled in this repository
and is not a file at that package's icons/ path.

ffmpeg-7.1-essentials-SOURCE-GAP.txt records the 2026-10-26 search of the
GitHub release, the essentials zip, the codexffmpeg tag, and gyan.dev.
Corresponding source was not in those places. The draft request to
builds@gyan.dev is ffmpeg-7.1-essentials-SOURCE-REQUEST.txt. It has not
been sent. Neither file clears the sale gate.

leaflet.markercluster-MIT-LICENCE.txt is
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster/v1.5.3/MIT-LICENCE.txt
SHA256 3133dacd38250bd1f524d8166cc60a016a382522e062fce143691c65bf5e4b3d.
The same bytes are the v1.5.2 file. The vendored JS and both CSS files match
unpkg leaflet.markercluster 1.5.2 and 1.5.3 dist. They do not match 1.5.1.

fontsource-OFL-1.1.txt is the LICENSE file of @fontsource/outfit 5.2.5,
SHA256 18aabf190848725e2576eefb5c29ba06aac1029d02132252a7f312eac2e50cf3.
@fontsource/sora 5.2.5 and @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono 5.2.6 contain the same
LICENSE bytes. All bundled Outfit and Sora woff2 files match those packages'
files/*-latin-*-normal.woff2. Both IBM Plex Mono woff2 files match 5.2.6.
The same woff2 bytes also match the previous patch of each package. The
LICENSE header attributes the fonts to Google Inc. and does not name
reserved font names.

These files are not an Orga Drone license. The project license stays MIT.
